caseName: Benedicto v. Porto Rican American Tobacco Co. of Porto Rico
caseNameFull: Jose E. Benedicto, as Treasurer of Porto Rico v. Porto Rican American Tobacco Company of Porto Rico
attorneys: Mr, Grant T. Trent, with whom Mr. F. Granville Munson was on the brief, for appellant. Mr. H. Lewis Brown, with whom Mr. Branch P. Kerfoot and Mr. A. PL. Burroughs were on the brief, for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Reversed with *689the direction to dismiss upon the authority of: (1) Irwin v. Wright, 258 U. S. 219, 222; Gorham Mfg. Co. v. Wendell, 261 U. S. 1, 5; (2) United States v. Hamburg-American Co., 239 U. S. 466, 475; Board of Public Utility Commissioners v. Compañia General, 249 U. S. 425, 426-427; Brownlow v. Schwartz, 261 U. S. 216, 217-218.

Mr, Grant T. Trent, with whom Mr. F. Granville Munson was on the brief, for appellant. Mr. H. Lewis Brown, with whom Mr. Branch P. Kerfoot and Mr. A. PL. Burroughs were on the brief, for appellee.
